column2: Endurance Offshore Deep Profiler: After deck deployment of the full mooring for the EA Offshore Deep Profiler (DP01B), this dive located and surveyed  the anchor for the docking station (PD01B). The cable OSHYW1 from LV01C was plugged into the docking station. A ROPOS-based CTD vertical survey was conducted of the water column alongside the profiler mooring line, and Niskin bottles were tripped at depths of 574, 501, 450, and 400 mbsl during ascent. The deep profiler was observed in an active downcast during this ascent. The transponder was retrieved from the top of the DP float near the end of the dive.
